title: PetitCure: Precure Fairies Season 3
titleNative: ぷちきゅあ～Precure Fairies～ シーズン3
synopsis: In Season 3, in addition to the familiar Mysterious Amusement Park and Candy Paradise, many new locations—including a lively performance stage—will make their debut! Furthermore, joining the ranks of our active heroes like PetitCure Mofurun and PetitCure Pollun, new friends such as PetitCure Purirun and PetitCure Meroron will also be appearing! Everything is even cuter when you're with a friend! ♪ Please look forward to more heartwarming and humorous stories that will leave you feeling cozy and healed by all the cute PetitCure. ♡ (Source: Official Website)

title: Reborn as a Cat
synopsis: Ji Miaomiao, a young woman just starting her career, is betrayed by a friend and left with a mountain of debt. While fleeing from ruthless debt collectors, she accidentally falls from a building. On the brink of death, a mysterious figure transforms her into a cat. By a twist of fate, she ends up being adopted—by none other than her own boss, Lu Chengze. Thus begins her strange and magical 100-day life... as a cat. (Source: Bilibili)

title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage
titleRomaji: Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musou: Nidome no Tensei, S-Rank Cheat Majutsushi Boukenroku
titleEnglish: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage
titleNative: 落第賢者の学院無双～二度目の転生、Sランクチート魔術師冒険録～
synonyms: The Unsuccessful Yet Academically Unparalleled Sage: A Cheating S-Rank Sorcerer's Post-Rebirth Adventurer Log
synopsis: Ephtal is reincarnated as a human, coming from modern Earth. In this new world where magic is real, he decides to devote the entirety of his life in the pursuit of magic. Despite his efforts, though, he discovers that he is absolutely talentless in magic, and breathed his last in anguish....But it isn't the end for him just yet! He reincarnates once again bearing the same name, Ephtal, 400 years later. Having retained his knowledge and power, he steals his resolve and once again sets his sights for the peak of magic! (Source: Comikey) Note: Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musou: Nidome no Tensei, S-Rank Cheat Majutsushi Boukenroku is streaming a week in advance of the TV broadcast on dAnimeStore, ABEMA, U-NEXT, and Anime Hodai beginning June 26th, 2026. Regular broadcasting begins on July 2nd, 2026.

synopsis: Born into a prestigious family of master swordsmen, Elymas Edvaughn’s future shatters when he awakens the so-called “defective” Heavy Knight class. Armed with knowledge no one else possesses, he sets out to rewrite his fate and prove the strength of the “weakest” class. (Source: Crunchyroll)
